request: Give members one free day before late fees start, and let them renew a loan that isn't late.
summary: Late fees start on the second day late. Members can renew an open loan for more days while it owes no late fee.

tasks.title: One free day before late fees
tasks.spec: late_fee_cents no longer charges the first day late: 1 day late costs 0, 3 days late costs 2 days' fee. Cap unchanged.

tasks.title: Renew a loan
tasks.spec: renew_loan extends an open loan's due date, refused when the loan owes a late fee today (fees.late_fee_cents).
